 Electricity
 Price          This price disclosure is an example based on average prices for Residential meter customers, and do not necessarily
                reflect your actual TDU charges as a non-Residential meter customer. Your actual average price for electric service
                will vary according to your usage. The price you pay each month will consist of the Base Charge, Energy Charge, and
                the TDU Delivery Charges, less the Think Smart Thermostat Credit, if any. TDU Delivery Charges include all recurring
                charges from your TDU passed through to you without mark-up. Failure to enroll an eligible thermostat, and/or
                opting out of more than [2] program events ins a billing period will result in forfeiture of the Think Smart Thermostat
                Credit for that billing period. Think Smart Thermostat Credit may be prorated for any days in the billing period during
                which any enrolled Thermostat is not connected or is not transmitting information to Think Energy for 8 or more
                hours.

                Each month your bill will also include (i) all applicable taxes, including sales tax and reimbursement for the state
                miscellaneous gross receipts tax, (ii) TDU fees for underground service (if applicable at your location), (iii) facility
                relocation fees or other charges ordered by a municipality. The average prices listed above do not include any of the
                charges listed in (i), (ii) or (iii).

                You will receive all contract documents and all other written communications from us via e-mail, text message or
                other electronic means.
